title: SIMQ: A Single Graph-based Index for Multi-Vector Query
abstract: arXiv:2611.22079v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-vector retrieval models such as ColBERT achieve state-of-the-art effectiveness by representing documents as sets of token-level vectors and scoring via MaxSim, but their high computational cost limits scalability to large corpora. Existing approximate methods face fundamental bottlenecks: centroid interaction matrix approaches require computing a full matrix at every query and rely on GPU-accelerated clustering, while data-oblivious compression methods yield unstable recall that requires repeated compensation. We propose SIMQ (Single graph Index for Multi-vector Query), a framework that bridges single-vector graph indices and multi-vector retrieval through data-aware sampling-based clustering and per-token graph navigation, simultaneously bypassing all aforementioned bottlenecks. SIMQ organizes all token vectors into fine-grained clusters via data-aware sampling, builds a single graph index over cluster centroids independently of P

translated_title: SIMQ：一种用于多向量查询的单一图索引
translated_abstract: 诸如ColBERT等多向量检索模型通过将文档表示为词元级向量的集合并使用MaxSim进行评分，实现了最先进的检索效果，但其高昂的计算成本限制了其在大规模语料库上的可扩展性。现有的近似方法面临根本性瓶颈：质心交互矩阵方法需要在每次查询时计算完整矩阵，并依赖GPU加速的聚类；而数据无关的压缩方法会产生不稳定的召回率，需要反复补偿。我们提出了SIMQ（面向多向量查询的单一图索引），这是一个通过数据感知的采样聚类和逐词元图导航来衔接单向量图索引与多向量检索的框架，同时规避了上述所有瓶颈。SIMQ通过数据感知采样将所有词元向量组织成细粒度的簇，并在簇质心上构建一个独立于...（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: SIMQ提出了一种基于单一图索引的多向量查询框架，通过数据感知的采样聚类和逐词元图导航，同时突破了现有近似方法在计算矩阵开销和召回稳定性方面的根本瓶颈。
